title: Docker security advisory (AV26-1153)
content_md: Serial number: AV26-1153 Date: November 12, 2026 As of November 10, 2026, Docker is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products: Docker Engine Prior to 23.0.0 Moby Prior to 2.0.0-beta.28 SwarmKit Prior to v1.12.1-0.20220307221335-616e8db4c3b0 Prior to 2.1.3 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply any necessary updates as they become available. Cluster-API proxy overwrites forwarded client identity with its own Docker security announcements Article Link: Docker security advisory (AV26-1153) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
